en.headline: Fixed-rate mortgages take 37.4% of new loans, an eight-year high
en.dek: The Monetary Authority's August survey shows fixed-rate plans rising for a 12th month, while newly approved mortgage lending fell to HK$32.2 billion.
body: Fixed-rate mortgages accounted for 37.4 per cent of newly approved residential mortgage loans in August, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's monthly survey showed, up 3.3 percentage points from July. The share has risen for 12 straight months and is the highest in more than eight years.

Newly approved mortgage lending fell 28.2 per cent on the month to HK$32.2 billion, and the number of cases fell 28.1 per cent to 6,090, both a six-month low, according to figures compiled from the survey. Loans tied to primary sales dropped 31.8 per cent to HK$9.1 billion, and those tied to secondary sales dropped 36.7 per cent to HK$15.3 billion. Refinancing loans rose 6.8 per cent to HK$7.8 billion. New applications fell 8.3 per cent to 8,446, a second monthly decline. Loans drawn down rose 11.6 per cent to HK$32.8 billion. Outstanding mortgage loans edged up 0.6 per cent to HK$1,975.4 billion, and the delinquency ratio stayed at 0.11 per cent.

Interbank-rate linked H-plans made up 57 per cent of new approvals, down 4 percentage points, while best-lending-rate P-plans rose to 1.9 per cent. RTHK, citing the survey, reported that refinancing cases rose for a seventh month and reached a 33-month high.

Wong Mei-fung, managing director of Centaline Mortgage, said higher valuations this year, larger cash rebates and low fixed-rate offers had drawn owners into refinancing. She said large banks' fixed rates were below H-plan rates and that September's fixed-rate share could reach 40 per cent. She added that a new floating "P then H" plan from a large bank, priced below fixed rates, was likely to take some of that share, with the effect showing in fourth-quarter figures.

zh.headline: 八月定息按揭佔新批貸款37.4% 創逾八年高
zh.dek: 金管局調查顯示，定息按揭佔比連升十二個月；新批住宅按揭貸款額跌至322億元。
body: 香港金融管理局住宅按揭統計調查顯示，八月新批住宅按揭貸款中，定息按揭佔37.4%，較七月升3.3個百分點，連升十二個月，再創逾八年高位。
同期新批出按揭貸款額按月減少28.2%至322億元，宗數減少28.1%至6090宗，同創近半年新低。涉及一手成交的貸款減少31.8%至91億元，二手成交減少36.7%至153億元，轉按則增加6.8%至78億元。新申請按揭個案按月減少8.3%至8446宗，連跌兩個月。新取用貸款額增加11.6%至328億元。未償還按揭貸款總額增加0.6%至19754億元，拖欠比率維持0.11%。
新批貸款中，與銀行同業拆息掛鈎的H按佔比降至57%，跌4個百分點；與最優惠利率掛鈎的P按升至1.9%。港台引述調查報道，轉按宗數連續七個月上升，創三十三個月新高。
中原按揭董事總經理王美鳳說，今年以來物業估值上升，銀行上調現金回贈並推出低息定息按揭，吸引業主轉按套現。她說大型銀行定按利率較H按低，不排除九月定按市佔率升至40%。她又指，有大型銀行近日推出息率較定按低的浮息「先P後H」計劃，相信會搶去部分定按佔比，具體數字要到第四季才反映。
